statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Its a big world down here, and we need our people to start branching out to explore it. That's where you come in.

The Kirin Tor is a member of an "Alliance" of like-minded nations. The de-facto heart of this alliance is the city of Stormwind to the south. Elaadrin has asked me to find someone to travel to Stormwind and meet with the regent lord there, a human named Bolvar Fordragon.

When you are ready, the Kirin Tor mages have set up a special portal for the High Order to use to access Stormwind.
narrative.objectives: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well met, champion. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect an emissary from the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 12 to 13, 2,555 XP in all.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Magical City of Dalaran
quests.objectiveText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Dalaran City and speak with Danaaris Stargale when you arrive.

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.objectiveText: Take the Skyborne Portal to Stormwind and report to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

quests.name: Exploring the Alliance
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions.
